relations.subject: Philip Glenn Whalen
relations.evidence: He attended Reed College on the GI Bill.   There, he met Gary Snyder and Lew Welch, and graduated with a BA in 1951.

relations.subject: Philip Glenn Whalen
relations.evidence: He moved into the San Francisco Zen Center and became a student of Zentatsu Richard Baker in 1972.

relations.subject: Philip Glenn Whalen
relations.evidence: He became head monk of Dharma Sangha, in Santa Fe, New Mexico in 1984.

relations.subject: Philip Glenn Whalen
relations.evidence: in 1991, he returned to San Francisco to lead the Hartford Street Zen Center until ill health forced him to retire.
